newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield falls to 6.99.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield falls to 6.99.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, sold 90-day treasury bills worth 160 million taka with a corresponding yield at 6.99 percent against 7.04 percent previously at an auction on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price against the bills was 98.28 per 100 taka against previous 98.27 taka.

It said the bank also sold 260 million taka worth of 30-day treasury bills with a corresponding yield at 6.03 percent compared with the previous 6.89 percent. The weighted average price was 99.5 per 100 against previous 99.43.
